crossRefs.note: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might…
When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid on him the cross, to carry…
Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of…
But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists…
Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger…
Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross, and come after me, can’t be my disciple.
If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

people.name: Cyrene

people.name: Rufus
people.line: Son of Simon of Cyrene, who carried Jesus' cross

people.name: Simon
people.line: A man who carried Jesus' cross on the way to crucifixion.

translations.web: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them, that he might bear his cross.
translations.bsb: Now Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, was passing by on his way in from the country, and the soldiers forced him to carry the cross of Jesus.
translations.kjv: And they compel one Simon a Cyrenian, who passed by, coming out of the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to bear his cross.
translations.asv: And they compel one passing by, Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them, that he might bear his cross.
